literal.prompt: Как называется лёд, который формируется непосредственно при замерзании поверхности океана?

literalGroups.primaryGround: NSIDC QuickFacts L70 directly defines sea ice as frozen ocean water forming/growing/melting in ocean. ShelfScience L68-L78 and GlacierScience L71/L77/L101 distinguish accumulated land-glacier ice, thick attached shelf and detached iceberg. Thus key0 is established independently of frozen index. All four are comparable ice categories; sea ice is the name for material directly frozen from ocean surface. Some coastal shelves can ultimately include sea ice (Larsen L123), but a thick stable coastal shelf is not the name of the direct freezing product specified by prompt.

Note сохраняет это различие без ложного универсального запрета исключений.
